about: Every Suno take made for this reel, kept so prompts and results can be compared and unused takes reused. Audio lives in the suno-archive release (archive links); suno_url opens the original at full quality.

takes.title: Unresolved Harmony
takes.note: Widest dynamics (LRA 11.4 LU), clearest quiet-build-recede; window 2:28.33-3:06.62 under the 38.3 s cut; loop resolves A major into D
takes.structure_cues:
[Instrumental]

[Intro - near silence, single low cello note, distant room tone]

[Verse - sparse felt piano, two notes at a time, wide space between phrases]

[Build - low strings enter, slow crescendo, tension, no percussion]

[Peak - sustained string swell, held, then sudden cut to silence]

[Release - one soft piano chord, cello sustains under it]

[Outro - unresolved suspended chord, fades to near silence, no final cadence]

prompts.title: 022 THE STATUE

[Build: slow cello pulse, stone fractures, second cello voice enters]
[Break: music drops to near silence, a single stone falls]
